# Memristive_SNN_Accelerator

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A hardware architecture that uses memristors to implement synaptic weights and neural dynamics in a spiking neural network for real-time sensory-motor tasks. Enables energy-efficient, in-network neuromorphic processing for bio-inspired interception, a core iNEST use case.
